details: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin has unveiled a multi-year roadmap for "Lean Ethereum," which is described as the network's largest transformation since The Merge. The plan prioritizes native privacy, quantum resistance, and protocol simplification, aiming for a simpler, faster, more private, and quantum-resistant network over the next three to four years.
title: Vitalik Buterin Unveils Major Ethereum Overhaul Towards "Lean Ethereum"

details: Bitcoin surged to nearly $64,000 in the early hours of July 6, extending a weekend rally. This move was primarily driven by a softer-than-expected US jobs report, which reduced expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes, and led to the liquidation of over $450 million in short positions across the derivatives market.
title: Bitcoin Spikes to $64K Amid Weak Jobs Data & Short Squeeze

details: Over $1.1 billion worth of altcoins are scheduled to be unlocked between July 6th and 12th. Major projects include Rain ($796M), Pump.fun ($135.5M), ADI Chain ($40.5M), Stable ($31.3M), and Hyperliquid ($30.9M). These significant token unlocks could introduce increased market volatility as new supply enters circulation.
title: Over $1.1 Billion in Altcoins to Unlock This Week

details: Strategy (MSTR) disclosed an $8.32 billion loss on digital assets for the three months ended June 30, 2026. The company also sold 2,225 Bitcoin for $135.2 million between July 1 and July 5 to fund preferred stock distributions and replenish its USD reserve. As of July 5, Strategy held 843,775 Bitcoin.
title: Strategy Reports $8.32B Bitcoin Loss, Sells BTC for Dividends

details: A statement from new Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh on July 1st, indicating that "inflation risks have come down," contributed to a relief rebound in crypto markets. This dovish tone from the Fed helped Bitcoin reclaim the $60,000 level and improved overall risk sentiment, suggesting a potentially better liquidity environment for riskier assets like cryptocurrencies.
title: Fed's Dovish Tone Boosts Crypto Market Sentiment

details: Cardano (ADA) has shown strong performance this summer, outperforming many large-cap cryptocurrencies after the market downturn in June. This resurgence is attributed to improving investor sentiment, an increase in wallet holders, and anticipation surrounding network upgrades such as Van Rossem and Leios, which are strengthening its long-term outlook.
title: Cardano Outperforms Altcoins Amid Summer Rally & Upgrades

details: Ripple has reportedly achieved full MiCA (Markets in Crypto-Assets) approval, securing a European-wide license for crypto services. This significant institutional development is seen as a boost for XRP, especially amidst ongoing discussions about potential ETF demand and a projected bounce in the second half of the year.
title: Ripple's XRP Gains Full MiCA Approval in Europe
